mentions.name: looot.ai
mentions.description: Pay-per-use platform that gives AI models access to a catalog of the best tools, with no subscription required.
mentions.problem: AI models have become very capable, but the missing piece was the connection to the tools they need.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AI models have gotten so good, that we felt that what we were missing was the connection to the tools, so I built

https://looot.ai/

No subscription, pay-per-use to allow your AI to access the best tools.
mentions.author: luisalima
